text:
omar: Quick check before RFC lands: do we actually want to keep dual-mode support (grpc internal + rest bridge) long-term or make grpc-only for internal teams?
kai: I'd prefer grpc-only internally but we need a migration path for the handful of teams on rest. Gateway translator buys time.
neha: telemetry is the tie-breaker for me. If we can attribute costs and latency per transport reliably, we can justify grpc-only. We need labels earlier in the pipeline.
sam: Can we do transport tagging in the tracer and also add a prometheus label via envoy? Example: add header x-transport and set tag in otel attr.
ci-bot: Remember to include compatibility check: buf breaking check and a go/proto-style guide in the RFC
deploy-bot: Canary started for canary-v3 -> 3% at 6139990030
omar: okay plan: short-term translator at the edge, inject x-transport, x-variant, x-proto-version; medium-term migrate services to grpc-only and sunset translator. Kai/neha/sam help own the metrics and console wiring.
kai: I'll prototype the console card that shows transport split + a 'force rest' button per tenant.
neha: alerting: create rule: if decode-failures > 5/min OR transport=grpc p50 latency > 300ms -> fire a non-paged alert and start autoswitch process.
sam: Also, include a scoreboard panel that displays per-route cost delta between grpc vs rest-bridge, so PMs can evaluate economics.
omar: Great. I'll include all this in the RFC.
